attributes.title: SUBSURFACE PROFILE

attributes.bodyText: Satellite observations are transformed into daily subsurface temperature profiles across the North Indian Ocean.

attributes.subtitle: Seven daily ocean and atmosphere variables
attributes.title: SATELLITE INPUTS

attributes.text:
SST + SALINITY
SEA LEVEL ANOMALY
OCEAN CURRENTS U/V
WINDS U/V

MODEL : OceanEmbed
INPUT WINDOW : 7 DAYS
GRID : 0.25 DEGREE
OUTPUT : 15 DEPTH LEVELS
DEPTH RANGE : 0 TO 1000 M
REGION : NORTH INDIAN OCEAN

attributes.bodyText: A satellite embedding-based deep learning framework reconstructing subsurface ocean temperature from surface observations.

attributes.subtitle: Daily satellite and ocean analyses provide the surface signals for subsurface profile reconstruction.

attributes.bodyText: The prototype covers 5 to 30 N and 45 to 105 E on a daily 0.25 degree grid, reconstructing temperature profiles from seven surface variables.
